entry_state: The priced guarantee produces four complete physical histories while preserving financial valuation and nonfinancial assumptions separately. Variable-fee movements,loss reversals,risk mitigation and partial reinsurance retain their causes. A qualifying modification uses an independently supplied equivalent premium and no invented cash. Fixed-claim finance separates current valuation from the profit/OCI allocation;the variable-benefit method begins next.
exit_state: Finance methods preserve current measurement,new presentation and old OCI origins separately. The claims process then shows how a joint law changes nonlinear treaty recovery despite identical marginals. Chain-ladder factors give point reserve148 but do not determine a payment law. Two-stage resampling distinguishes fitted means from process payments and preserves shared-fit dependence;the sparse-data and failed-draw discussion has begun.
findings: Revised variable benefits require a revised systematic allocation;retaining10% would leave an unexplained23 at settlement. Current valuation still uses its separately supplied market-consistent rate.
An old OCI reclassification schedule retains frozen assumptions when current holdings and values change;derecognition follows its original policy rather than only today's label.
The binary claim family derives recovery20a over a in[0,1/2];independence is one member,not information implied by the marginals.

The reserve/payment example derives variance19 rather than fitted-mean variance9,and a second equal-moment law changes the tail. Shared fitted means also make aggregate variance56 rather than38. No new confirmed local defect.
